name: PSX2PSP-Reborn
description: Native Rust POPS EBOOT.PBP builder for PSP & PS Vita: bit-perfect PBP, multi-disc, live GPU XMB preview, ICON1/SND0 from YouTube, built-in patch database for ~2,000 PS1 games.
long_description: One native binary. Bit-perfect PBP, multi-disc up to five, a game patch database with ~2,000 titles, an animated ICON1.PMF and SND0.AT3 cut from any YouTube video , and a live, GPU-rendered XMB that shows the result before you copy it to the memory stick.
